name: defer-tools
description: Lists rarely used built-in and host tools behind ToolSearch, so their schemas load only when a session asks for them, shows the tokens that saves, and lets you choose which tools to hide and what the display shows, with a plain line on what each tool is for.

alsoDefer.title: Also defer
alsoDefer.description: Comma-separated tool names to list behind ToolSearch as well, e.g. mcp__server__tool.

keepInFront.title: Keep in front
keepInFront.description: Comma-separated tool names from the default list to leave in the prompt, e.g. Workflow.

statusLine.title: Show savings in the status line
statusLine.description: Show a line under the prompt with the tokens defer-tools saves per request.
